parsed.rationale: Both participating records carry `is_test: true` — `MockDiscogsEntityResolver.resolveArtist` in `Shared/Metadata/Tests/MetadataTests/DiscogsMarkupParserTests.swift` (package `Metadata`) and `MockDiscogsEntityResolver.resolveMaster` in `WXYC/iOS/Tests/WXYCTests/DiscogsFormatterTests.swift` (package `app:iOS`). Per the restraint rules, any cluster where even one record is test-scoped must be treated as a test-fixture and left alone. Here both records are test-scoped, making the case unambiguous. Merging or genericizing these two test-only mock methods would couple distinct test suites across package boundaries without any production benefit.
